About the Role:

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to build scalable cloud-native applications powering next-generation intelligence products. The role involves developing highly scalable web applications, dashboards, analytics platforms, and AI-driven operational systems for global shipping customers.

Key Responsibilities:
Design and develop scalable web applications and microservices.
Build responsive user interfaces and analytics dashboards.
Develop RESTful APIs and backend services.
Integrate AI/ML services into customer-facing products.
Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and security.
Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and DevOps teams.
Participate in architecture discussions and technical decision-making.
Required Skills:
Strong experience in React.js/Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and state management libraries (Redux or equivalent).
Hands-on experience with Node.js and/or Python for backend development and REST API design.
Good understanding of Microservices Architecture and scalable application development.
Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
Proficiency in at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Strong understanding of application performance, scalability, security, and software engineering best practices.

Role & responsibilities




As a Backend Engineer, youll design, build, and maintain the server-side systems that power our applications. You’ll focus on how data is stored, processed, and served via APIs—ensuring our services are performant, secure, reliable, and scalable.

Key responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain backend services like procedure/functions linked to APIs for integrations.

- Build and optimise data models, database queries, and storage strategies.

- Ensure high performance and reliability through profiling, monitoring, and tuning.

- Implement secure-by-design practices (authentication/authorisation, data protection, secure coding).

- Design scalable architectures and contribute to system design decisions.

- Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code; contribute to code reviews and engineering standards.

- Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive preventative improvements.

- Collaborate with frontend engineers, product, QA, and platform/SRE teams to deliver end-to-end outcomes.

- Document APIs, services, and operational runbooks to support long-term maintainability.

Skills & Experience

- Strong backend engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and distributed systems basics.

- Experience building server-side applications and APIs (REST and/or event-driven patterns).

- Solid understanding of databases like PostgreSQL, indexing, transactions, and data consistency.

- Practical experience with testing strategies (unit/integration), CI/CD, and version control.

- Ability to design systems that handle high throughput and large volumes of operational tasks.

- Strong problem-solving skills and a language-agnostic mindset.

- We’re open to engineers proficient in any of the following: Python, Java, C++, C#, Clojure, CoffeeScript, F#, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, TypeScript, Scala.

About the Role:




We are looking for a highly skilled Serverless Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable, event-driven, serverless applications in a cloud-native environment. In this role, you will develop high-performance backend services using serverless architectures, enabling rapid delivery, minimal overhead, and high availability. You will collaborate with development, DevOps, and cloud infrastructure teams to deliver secure and efficient solutions that align with modern application development standards.




Key Responsibilities:



Design, develop, and maintain serverless applications using cloud-native services (e.g., AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, Google Cloud Functions).

Build APIs, event-driven systems, and microservices architectures using serverless paradigms.

Integrate serverless functions with other cloud services (e.g., DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, Firestore).

Optimize serverless applications for performance, cost-efficiency, and scalability.

Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.

Monitor and debug live systems, leveraging observability tools and logs.

Ensure applications are secure, resilient, and compliant with industry standards.

Collaborate with frontend, DevOps, and product teams to integrate business logic and improve user experience.



Preferred Skills:



AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified Developer Associate, AWS Certified Solutions Architect).

Experience with GraphQL, WebSockets, or real-time architectures.

Familiarity with event streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis).

Understanding of DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CodePipeline).

Experience with multi-region deployments and high-availability design patterns.

Exposure to security and compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2).

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Kafka Engineer to design, implement, and maintain robust event-driven data pipelines and real-time streaming applications. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Apache Kafka, data streaming architectures, and distributed systems, and will play a critical role in ensuring the high availability, performance, and scalability of our data infrastructure.
 
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and manage Kafka-based data streaming solutions .
Set up, configure, and maintain Kafka clusters , brokers, topics, and schemas.
Monitor, optimize, and ensure the availability and performance of Kafka services.
Implement Kafka Connect , Kafka Streams , and Schema Registry as needed.
Develop producers and consumers for real-time data ingestion and processing.
Collaborate with DevOps, Data Engineering, and Backend teams to integrate Kafka with other systems (eg, Spark, Flink, MongoDB, PostgreSQL).
Automate deployment, scaling, and recovery of Kafka components.
Implement monitoring and alerting tools (eg, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk).
Ensure data security , compliance , and governance across Kafka pipelines.
Participate in on-call rotations and provide support for production systems.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
2+ years of hands-on experience with Apache Kafka in production environments.
Strong programming skills in Java , Scala , or Python .
Experience with Kafka Connect , Kafka Streams , and Kafka REST Proxy .
Solid understanding of distributed systems, messaging systems, and real-time data processing.
Familiarity with Docker , Kubernetes , and CI/CD pipelines .
Experience with monitoring tools like Confluent Control Center , Prometheus , Grafana , or Datadog .
Proficiency with Linux/Unix systems and scripting.
